jobs.title: Director of Partnerships & Growth
jobs.description:
Director of Partnerships & Growth

Role purpose

The primary goal is generating partnership revenue.

This person reports directly to the founders and works across media, community, enterprise training, and revenue operations.

Media partnerships

Turn the newsletter, website, social audience, podcast/video, webinars, and events into clearly defined sponsorship packages.
Build and manage a pipeline of proptech, AI, data, financial-services, construction tech, infrastructure tech, and professional-services companies.
Conduct outreach, discovery calls, presentations, and negotiations.
Create proposals and close new partnerships.
Coordinate campaign launches with the content and production team.
Provide sponsors with campaign reporting.
Manage renewals and expand successful partnerships.
Maintain a sponsorship calendar so the company does not oversell its audience.
Protect editorial independence and ensure paid partnerships are clearly distinguished from editorial coverage.

Enterprise training and membership sales

Respond to incoming training and team-membership inquiries.
Research prospective companies before calls.
Conduct initial qualification calls.
Help determine which training offer fits the prospect.
Prepare proposals and manage follow-up.
Keep longer sales processes moving.
Bring founders into important calls at the appropriate stage.
Close smaller workshops and team plans independently over time.
Coordinate the transition from sales into training delivery.
Maintain relationships that can lead to additional training, memberships, or sponsorships.

The founders would initially remain responsible for scoping and closing the largest custom engagements.

Revenue operations

Maintain the CRM and make sure every opportunity has a clear next step.
Produce a simple weekly pipeline and revenue forecast.
Track sponsorship inventory, contracts, invoices, payments, and renewal dates.
Create reusable proposal, email, and follow-up templates.
Document the company’s developing sales process.
Report which offers, audiences, industries, and outreach messages are converting.
Help the founders decide what new products or packages the market actually wants.
Take on occasional growth-related startup projects when priorities change.

Ideal candidate

Approximately five to eight years of sales experience.
Experience in B2B media, sponsorships, events, partnerships, community businesses, proptech, or another industry publication.
Polished enough to speak with founders, executives, and enterprise clients.
Comfortable personally prospecting and closing business.
Strong writer who can create convincing outreach and proposals.
Highly organized and reliable with follow-up.
Comfortable working without a large support team or established playbook.
Genuinely interested in building relationships and helping community members.
Able to move between strategy and detailed execution.
Interested in AI and commercial real estate, although deep expertise in both is not required initially.
Comfortable working for a startup.
Comfortable working in a fast paced environment.
Comfortable wearing multiple hats.

Executive Director

Job Title:
Executive Director

Organization:
Asheville Poverty Initiative (API)

Application Deadline:
October 16, 2026

Position Type:
Full-time, salaried

Classification:
Exempt Employee

Position Overview

Asheville Poverty Initiative (API) is a nonprofit organization based in West Asheville, N.C. A steadfast presence for over a decade at the intersection of State Street and Haywood Road, API builds community through our signature programs, 12 Baskets Café and Realities of Poverty Education. API’s work is to dismantle stereotypes by sharing meals and telling stories across socio-economic differences. The Board of Directors is hiring an Executive Director who will lead API with a high level of integrity and empathy into its second decade of meaningful community engagement and change.

The new Executive Director of the Asheville Poverty Initiative will have successful leadership experience and the ability to oversee fundraising, programs, and overall operations while working effectively with the staff, volunteers, and the board. The Executive Director will be able to listen, communicate effectively, and build relationships with multiple constituencies throughout the community.

Compensation& Benefits:
Salary – $80,000.

How to apply:

jobs.title: Senior Director of Operations
jobs.description:
Senior Director of Operations (HUB & Access Programs)

Location:
Remote

Lead enterprise-wide HUB and patient access programs that help patients overcome barriers to life-changing therapies. My client is seeking an accomplished operations leader to drive performance, scalability, and exceptional service across a growing portfolio of healthcare programs.

Why You Should Apply

Shape high-impact patient access programs at the enterprise level
Fully remote leadership opportunity
Influence strategy, technology, operations, and client growth
Lead programs that directly improve patients’ access to therapy
Amazing Benefit Package
Competitive Comp Package

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead HUB and patient access operations across enterprise clients
Translate contracts, SLAs, and program requirements into scalable workflows
Own SLA performance, SOWs, renewals, compliance, revenue, and margin
Drive cross-functional execution across pharmacy, technology, product, implementation, and analytics
Establish executive reporting, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives

About You

Bachelor’s in Business, Healthcare Administration, or related field required; MBA/advanced degree preferred
Deep expertise in HUB services, patient access, specialty pharmacy, or healthcare operations
Executive-level client relationship skills
Strong SOW, SLA, financial, and analytical capabilities
Proven ability to scale complex operations and influence cross-functional teams

How To Apply

We’d love to see your resume, but we don’t need it to have a conversation. Send us an email to max@scientificsearch.com and tell me why you’re interested. Or, feel free to email your resume. Please include Job#20083.
